description: The switch of the stream ports: the output of one port (a module's stream, a provider) goes to the inputs of the ports linked from it, unchanged.

commands.label: Connect two ports
commands.description: The output of the first port goes to the input of the second. The same again changes nothing; one output goes to at most CONFIG_DATA_STREAM_TARGETS ports.

fields.label: From
fields.description: The sending port: DATA_STREAM_PORT(kind, id), the kind (0 module, 1 provider) in the high byte

fields.label: To
fields.description: The taking port: DATA_STREAM_PORT(kind, id), the kind (0 module, 1 provider) in the high byte

commands.label: Disconnect two ports
commands.description: Removes that connection; not there: nothing changes.

fields.label: From
fields.description: The sending port: DATA_STREAM_PORT(kind, id), the kind (0 module, 1 provider) in the high byte

fields.label: To
fields.description: The taking port: DATA_STREAM_PORT(kind, id), the kind (0 module, 1 provider) in the high byte

returns.label: Number of connections
returns.description: Then that many connections (from u16, to u16).
